description: A single-panel table rendered as an image (no curves, spectra or micrographs), organised into four stacked blocks of crystallographic interface data for inclusions reported in Fe-15Mn-Al-C low-density steel. The first block lists three MnS/Al2O3 interfaces — MnS(100)/Al2O3(001), MnS(110)/Al2O3(001) and MnS(111)/Al2O3(001) — each with three candidate orientation pairs. Columns give the direction indices [uvw]MnS and [uvw]Al2O3 (or AlN/TiN), the matching interplanar spacings dMnS, dAl2O3, dAlN, dTiN in Å, the rotation angle θ in degrees and the lattice mismatch δ in percent. The second block covers AlN(001)/Al2O3(001); the third covers MnS(100)/AlN(100), MnS(110)/AlN(110) and MnS(111)/AlN(111); the fourth covers (110)TiN//(100)MnS. Printed θ values are 0, 15, 30, 5.264 and 6.06°, and δ is given only for the single selected row pair per interface (12.59, 8.41, 28.83, 11.66, 8.94, 28.78, 28.78, 11.65%). The table demonstrates that every inclusion/oxide and inclusion/nitride interface can be described by a low-angle, low-mismatch orientation relationship, with δ ranking the candidate parallelisms per interface.

subfigures.description: MnS/Al2O3 interfaces table: MnS(100)/Al2O3(001), MnS(110)/Al2O3(001) and MnS(111)/Al2O3(001), each with three [uvw] direction pairs; dMnS/dAl2O3 in Å (e.g. 5.224/4.759, 9.048/9.518, 6.398/8.243); θ in degrees (30, 15, 0, 5.264, 0); δ only for selected rows: 12.59, 8.41 and 28.83%.

MnS/AlN interfaces: MnS(100)/AlN(100), MnS(110)/AlN(110) and MnS(111)/AlN(111), each with three direction pairs; dMnS 4.069–2.877 Å versus dAlN 3.705–9.076 Å; θ = 0° everywhere; δ = 8.94, 28.78 and 28.78% for the three interfaces respectively.

(110)TiN//(100)MnS interface with direction pairs [001]||[001], [-111]||[011] and [-110]||[010]; listed spacings dTiN = 0.431, 0.746, 0.609 Å and dMnS = 0.537, 0.759, 0.537 Å; θ = 0, 6.06 and 0°; single δ = 11.65%.

observations.observation: The figure is a text table, not a plot or micrograph, and contains no axis, legend, scale bar or image panel.
For MnS(100)/Al2O3(001) the printed pair [uvw]MnS = [002] || [uvw]Al2O3 = [-100] has dMnS = 5.224 Å, dAl2O3 = 4.759 Å and θ = 30°, with the δ cell left blank.
For MnS(110)/Al2O3(001) the selected pair is [222] || [-200] with dMnS = 9.048 Å, dAl2O3 = 9.518 Å, θ = 5.264° and δ = 8.41%.
For MnS(111)/Al2O3(001) the selected pair is [-211] || [-110] with dMnS = 6.398 Å, dAl2O3 = 8.243 Å, θ = 0° and δ = 28.83%.
For AlN(001)/Al2O3(001) the tabulated [-300] || [-110] pair has dAlN = 9.330 Å and dAl2O3 = 8.243 Å, θ = 0° and δ = 11.66%.
MnS/AlN interfaces carry δ = 8.94% for MnS(100)/AlN(100) but 28.78% for both MnS(110)/AlN(110) and MnS(111)/AlN(111), all with θ = 0°.
For (110)TiN//(100)MnS the selected pair is [-111] || [011] with dTiN = 0.746 Å, dMnS = 0.759 Å, θ = 6.06° and δ = 11.65%.
θ is 0° for most parallel direction pairs; the only non-zero values printed anywhere in the table are 30°, 15°, 5.264° and 6.06°.
The δ column is populated only for the single selected direction pair of each interface; all other δ cells in that interface are blank.

In the (110)TiN//(100)MnS block the listed spacings (dTiN 0.431, 0.746, 0.609 Å; dMnS 0.537, 0.759, 0.537 Å) are about ten times smaller than the values listed in every other block (2.877–9.518 Å), which suggests a possible unit/typo inconsistency in the source table rather than genuinely sub-ångström interplanar spacings.

The caption is identical to the table content itself, i.e. it reproduces the same Interface / [uvw] / d / θ / δ rows, and asserts a lattice-mismatch calculation between MnS, AlN and TiN and Al2O3 in the Fe-15Mn-Al-C low-density steel.

unreadable_items: No table cell is illegible; however the δ row entries for non-selected direction pairs are blank in the original table and therefore carry no value
the physical meaning of the anomalously small dTiN/dMnS values in the (110)TiN//(100)MnS block cannot be resolved from the image alone
